prompt: Flatten a list of lists into one flat ArrayList, keeping every element in its original order.
explanation: A nested list is walked with two for-each loops: the outer loop visits each inner list, the inner loop visits each element. Appending to a single result list as you go preserves the original order automatically. addAll(innerList) could replace the inner loop -- both approaches copy elements without modifying the input.
hints: You need two loops: the outer one iterates over the inner lists, the inner one over their elements.
for (ArrayList<Integer> innerList : nested) gives you each inner list in turn.
Add every element to one result ArrayList created before the loops; result.addAll(innerList) is a shortcut for the inner loop.
